title: Debugging & Troubleshooting
description: Debug complex issues: race conditions, memory leaks, performance problems, logic errors

problems.title: Find the Race Condition
problems.description: Debug a concurrent counter implementation that occasionally produces incorrect results due to a race condition.
requirements: Fix without using locks if possible (atomic operations)
If locks needed, use minimal locking scope
Add test proving fix works under contention

problems.title: Memory Leak Investigation
problems.description: Find and fix a memory leak in a caching system that grows unboundedly over time.
requirements: Fix the leaks while maintaining functionality

problems.title: Performance Bottleneck
problems.description: Optimize a slow function that processes user data. Current runtime is O(n^3), needs to be O(n) or O(n log n).
requirements: Reduce time complexity to O(n) or O(n log n)

problems.title: Deadlock Detection
problems.description: Find and fix a deadlock in a banking transfer system that freezes under concurrent transfers.
requirements: Fix using lock ordering or other technique

problems.title: Off-by-One Errors
problems.description: Find and fix multiple off-by-one errors in array/string manipulation code.
